title: ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.14382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. translated_title: ANASSA：面向空间智能体AI的从高层框架到低层架构
translated_abstract: 在地理空间数据上运行的智能体AI系统不仅需要自主推理和工具使用能力，还必须支持显式编排、空间验证、治理、溯源、故障处理以及人类决策权威。先前的工作提出了ANASSA，这是一个面向空间智能的智能体AI编排框架，为受治理的智能体执行建立了高层组件和职责边界（arXiv:2609.14824）。然而，该框架并未说明这些高层职责应如何被系统地分解为面向实现的低层架构。本文通过应用设计科学研究方法（DSR）来填补这一空白，将ANASSA框架从高层架构（HLA）职责细化为低层架构（LLA）。所得设计在将职责边界转化为可执行架构的同时，保留了基础框架的职责边界。
tldr: 本文应用设计科学研究方法，将面向空间智能的ANASSA智能体AI编排框架从高层架构职责系统地细化为可执行的低层架构，同时完整保留其治理职责边界。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Design Science Research to systematically refine the ANASSA agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence from high-level architectural responsibilities into an executable low-level architecture, while preserving its governance responsibility boundaries.
